name: artlux-launcher
description: ArtLux Launcher — installs ArtLux, checks the machine, and opens projects.
comment: Deliberately NOT a member of the root npm workspaces (packages/*, plugins/*). The root lockfile must stay reproducible for the app build; a UI dep tree for a separate product in it is how `npm ci` broke in v0.18.0. Install with `npm install` from inside this folder.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-preflight.cjs && node scripts/sync-tokens.cjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build
